author: Multiplayer Everything
name: Exit 8 Together

needs: Your own copy of The Exit 8 on Steam.
Everyone you play with needs the same version of the mod. A different version is refused, with both versions named.
For play over the internet: a VPN such as Tailscale or ZeroTier, or TCP port 27080 forwarded on the host's PC.
steps: Press Install. The launcher finds your copy of the game and puts the UE4SS mod loader and the mod next to Exit8-Win64-Shipping.exe. If it asks for the game's folder, pick steamapps\common\Exit8\Exit8\Binaries\Win64 (the folder with Exit8-Win64-Shipping.exe), not the top Exit8 folder.
Open the game folder's Exit8\Binaries\Win64\ue4ss\Mods\Exit8Together\config.txt in a text editor. The host sets mode = host. Friends set mode = join and address = the host's IP address.
Press Launch on every PC. The game starts through Steam.
Start a run together. Walk up to the forward exit or the turn-back line to vote: when everyone stands at the same line, you all go that way.
tips: This is an early test build. It has only been tested with two copies on one PC. Steam lobby play (transport = steam) and the Exit 8 ending are not tested yet.
There is no in-game menu yet: every setting is in config.txt. Restart the game after editing it.
Start together: joining a run that has already started isn't handled.
If anyone is caught, everyone starts over together.
Each PC still keeps its own save.

description: Co-op for The Exit 8 (Steam). Walk the same looping corridor with up to three friends: the same anomalies, the same exit count, and the group votes which way to go. Early test build.

launch.hint: Set mode = host or mode = join in the mod's config.txt first. Everyone starts the run together.
